caption: The drawing depicts a banjo-style wall clock with a round silver clock face at the top, featuring black hour and minute hands and black markings for hours. Above the clock face, there is a gold-colored eagle ornament perched on top. The neck of the clock, below the face, is elongated and tapers slightly, decorated with vertical symmetrical patterns in red, orange, green, and purple on a white background. The base section of the clock is square-shaped with a framed, colored scene showing figures and a ship on water, enclosed within a yellow-bordered frame adorned with floral patterns. The clock case appears to be made of wood, as indicated by the brown color on the sides, and the lower end of the clock terminates in a gold, ornate, fluted bracket with a finial at the bottom. The drawing is set against a plain off-white background with a slight rectangular border.
title: Banjo Clock
